content: Ligand 1 is the 3-fluoropyridine variant at jnk3 0.11 - one of my fatal-position results, and a good reminder that this pharmacophore has very tight steric requirements around the hinge. Atom 0 is its pyridine 4-methyl over an acyclic bond, the usual anchor. This finishes the central-ring methyl scan: with the arylamine at C1 and the anilide meta at C3, I have taken C4 and C5 and C2 in other episodes, so this one is C6 - ortho to the arylamine and para to the anilide. That is the mirror image of the C4 position, which is ortho to the anilide and para to the arylamine, so the pair of them tells me whether the ring wants bulk next to the amine or next to the amide. Between the four positions I will have the complete map, the same way the pyridine scan gave me a complete map. Everything else held: meta geometry, 4-methylpyridine, cyclopropanecarboxamide cap. Expected product: about 281 Da.
